purpose: Recording only; preserve original command validation, Actor, response, done, safety gates and acknowledgement ordering.

native_telemetry.write: Original synchronous 50Hz line write; no queue or drop introduced
native_telemetry.outer_fields: All outer fields retain their original values
native_telemetry.changed_nested_field: closed_loop_read_evidence removes repeated raw_utf8 and full decoded envelopes; preserves read/source integer stamps, actual commands, TTL/ages, raw SHA, controller_source and acceptance SHA. The complete original wire text is external.

original_commands.trigger: Consecutive command sequence or original raw_bytes_sha256 change
original_commands.body: Exact original UTF8 command bytes, no decoded duplicate
original_commands.loss: Nonblocking optional writer; overflow or I/O failure marks capture incomplete. Does not modify physical commands.

height_sources.outside_detail: Retain scalar source/count/clip summaries; omit the four 187-point raw/hit_z/valid/model arrays

raw_sensors.body: Exact original ROS2 CDR serialized sensor message, including original header, fields, data, padding and endian flag
raw_sensors.adapted_stage: ROS sensor adapter output before FAST-LIVO preprocessing; not claimed to be the kind4 preprocessed cloud
raw_sensors.truth: Existing native telemetry joined offline; no truth topic subscription or navigation publication
raw_sensors.loss: Written/attempted and eligible-message counters, stamp gaps, publisher graph, writer errors and truncation must be checked. Zero local writer loss does not prove zero upstream DDS loss.

binary_format.record: Little-endian uint64 metadata_bytes, uint64 body_bytes; UTF8 JSON metadata; exact body bytes
binary_format.integrity: Each metadata stores body byte count and SHA256. Original command bodies also verify the actual read raw SHA. read_records rejects corrupt/truncated records.

runtime_assertions.ground_classification: Offline analysis separates level floor top, ramp top, step/stair top and other surfaces; steps, ramps, sides and bottoms are excluded from floor-ground-only counts.
